sentences.en: He tried to wean his son from his bad habit.
sentences.zh: 他试图戒掉儿子的坏习惯。

sentences.en: By the end of the summer, this giraffe calf will be completely weaned.
sentences.zh: 到了夏天结束时，这只长颈鹿幼崽将完全断奶。

sentences.en: After she had weaned Lo-ruhamah she became pregnant and gave birth to a son.
sentences.zh: 她在断奶Lo-ruhamah之后怀孕并生下了一个儿子。
